text:
ajay: Quick sync — AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace onboarding. AWS PM sent checklist: final legal blurb, AMI/VM image, product tile (PNG), SKU mapping, pricing tiers. Can partnerships + product + eng confirm owners? cc @maria @sophie

maria: I can own coord with AWS and Azure. Sophie, can product finalize the 1-line and three bullets for marketplace tile by EOD Wed?

sophie: Yes. I'll draft and drop in /drive by tomorrow. Need any specific compliance callouts?

nina: For legal blurb — we need the liability paragraph + data residency note for EU. I can produce two variants: one short (for tile) and one full (for listing). ETA Thu morning.

kevin: Engineering: we'll build the AMI + GCP image this week. Two asks: 1) confirm instance types to test for perf; 2) what image signing/KMS keys to use for marketplace packaging.

ajay: For instance types, start with g5.2x and a2-highgpu-1g for AWS & GCP equivalent (nvidia a100/sim). We'll finalize after perf run. For keys, Nina, do we use Redwood KMS or customer-specific?

nina: Use Redwood KMS for published images. We'll need a KMS policy doc for the marketplace upload. I'll ping Security for the KMS ARN.

kevin: Cool. Also FYI — marketplace requires product tile: 1400x800 png, <2MB. And an icons set. Putting upload script here for reference:

```bash
# upload assets
aws s3 cp tile.png s3://redwood-marketplace-assets/1768451234/ --acl public-read
# create SKU mapping
echo '{"sku":"RW-INF-DED-1","pricing":"monthly","units":"vCPU_hours"}' > sku.json
```

maria: Thanks. @marketplace-bot can you re-run the SKU validation once we push sku.json?

marketplace-bot: sku-validator: queued SKU check for RW-INF-DED-1 — will post results here. :gear:

ajay: One more thing — GCP needs a short product description (150 chars) + long (500). Sophie pls include keywords: "low-latency inference", "dedicated GPU", "SLA".

sophie: Got it. Draft incoming.

maria: Action items summary:
- Maria: coordinate AWS/Azure PM threads & upload marketing assets to shared drive (due Fri)
- Sophie: write short + long descriptions and bullets (due Wed EOD)
- Nina: legal blurb variants + KMS policy (due Thu AM)
- Kevin: build AMI/GCP image + run perf on selected instance types (start Thurs)
- Ajay: confirm pricing tiers with finance and share SKU template (due Thu)

kevin: I'll post perf run logs to #eng-runtime and link back here.

ajay: Perfect. If anyone hits a blocker ping me. Otherwise we'll reconvene Fri 11am PT for final check before uploads. :calendar:
